name: r14-plain256-ef-el
author: solx-loop
description: The simplest one-shot kernel (16 threads per 512-B row, one LDG.256 and one STG.256 per thread, 4 shuffles) already streams at the B200's practical rate; the only measurable lever is L2 policy, because the harness's write-flush leaves L2 full of dirty lines and every line we allocate forces a write-back. L2::evict_first on input loads and L2::evict_last on output stores cut 3-24% per size on the rented B200. The current best evidently uses equivalent hints: this candidate is level with it, not a
